description: Known journey failures recorded by Phase 01 (Sept-23 Kaizen). The runner reports a failing test that matches an entry as BASELINE-FAIL instead of FAIL. Tests never encode these as skipped or expected-to-fail. When an owning phase fixes the defect, the runner reports 'PASS (baseline cleared)' and the entry must be removed in that phase.

entries.reason: Invalid files and the duplicate copy become catalogue cards (17 shown, 12 expected); cover share below 80 % while covers are generated.
Page turns take about 0.5-0.8 s each, Next presses are ignored while a turn is in flight, and the reader stalls before 50 turns.
Search returns no or wrong results for title, author, phrase, typo and Unicode probes.
0-byte, non-PDF, truncated and password-protected files are shown as normal books with no needs-attention indicator.
With AI unconfigured the Advisor offers no route to Settings (dead end).
After the PDF worker is killed the reader never renders another page and shows no recoverable message (no respawn yet).
A corrupt library-settings.json is logged but the user sees no message.
Search returns no result items to audit, so search-result names cannot be checked.
